theme: 教材字彙・基礎 550–650 第 30 群

items.pos: n. 零錢；變化 | v. 更改
items.colloc: small change 小額零錢 | make a change 做出改變
items.distinct: exchange 交換 | alter 修改
ex: Do you have any change for the vending machine?
你有投幣販賣機需要的零錢嗎？
We need to change the meeting room reservation.
我們需要更改會議室的預約。
Market trends are subject to constant change.
市場趨勢隨時都在變化。

items.colloc: collect data 收集資料 | collect a package 領取包裹
items.distinct: gather 聚集 | pick up 接送；領取
ex: Please collect your badges at the reception desk.
請至接待櫃檯領取識別證。
We are collecting feedback from our clients.
我們正在收集客戶的意見回饋。
The company will collect donations for charity.
公司將為慈善機構募集捐款。

items.pos: n. 佣金；委員會 | v. 委任
items.colloc: earn a commission 賺取佣金 | set up a commission 成立委員會
items.distinct: fee 費用 | committee 委員會（成員）
ex: Sales staff earn a commission on every deal.
業務人員每完成一筆交易都有佣金。
The government commissioned a study on traffic.
政府委任進行一項交通研究。
She serves on the planning commission.
她在規劃委員會任職。

items.colloc: confuse A with B 把A與B搞混 | be confused by 對...感到困惑
items.distinct: puzzle 使難倒 | mix up 搞混
ex: The new tax regulations confused many employees.
新的稅務規定讓許多員工感到困惑。
Don't confuse the two project proposals.
不要把這兩份專案提案搞混了。
I was confused by the complicated instructions.
我被複雜的說明書弄糊塗了。

items.colloc: determine the cause 確定原因 | determined to do 決心做某事
items.distinct: decide 決定 | identify 識別
ex: Market demand will determine the product price.
市場需求將決定產品價格。
We must determine the cause of the system error.
我們必須查明系統錯誤的原因。
Management is trying to determine the project timeline.
管理層正試圖確定專案時程。

items.pos: adj. 早期的 | adv. 提早
items.colloc: early bird 早起的人 | early stage 早期階段
items.distinct: soon 不久後 | beforehand 事先
ex: Please arrive early for the board meeting.
請提早出席董事會議。
This is just the early stage of development.
這只是開發的早期階段。
They finished the construction project early.
他們提早完成了施工專案。

items.colloc: encouraging news 令人振奮的消息 | show encouraging signs 顯示樂觀跡象
items.distinct: hopeful 充滿希望的 | positive 正面的
ex: The sales results for this quarter are encouraging.
本季的銷售業績令人鼓舞。
We received encouraging feedback from the focus group.
我們從焦點小組獲得了正面的回饋。
It is encouraging to see such high participation.
看到如此高的參與度令人感到振奮。

items.zh: 給予權利；符合資格；命名
items.colloc: be entitled to 有權享有 | entitle someone to do 賦予某人做...的權利
items.distinct: qualify 取得資格 | name 命名
ex: This ticket entitles you to a free meal.
這張票讓你有權享用免費餐點。
All employees are entitled to annual leave.
所有員工都有權享有年假。
The book is entitled 'Modern Business Strategies'.
這本書的書名為《現代商業策略》。

items.pos: n. 進入；登記；參賽項目
items.colloc: data entry 資料輸入 | entry level 入門級
items.distinct: entrance 入口 | access 使用權
ex: She works in the data entry department.
她在資料輸入部門工作。
The company is looking for an entry-level assistant.
公司正在招募入門級助理。
Please register your entry at the front desk.
請在櫃檯登記您的入場資訊。

items.colloc: highly experienced 非常有經驗 | experienced in 擅長於
items.distinct: expert 專家的 | skillful 技巧嫻熟的
ex: We need an experienced manager for this project.
我們需要一位有經驗的經理來負責此專案。
She is experienced in international trade.
她在國際貿易方面經驗豐富。
The team is led by experienced professionals.
該團隊由資深專業人士領導。

items.colloc: fairly common 相當常見 | treat fairly 公平對待
items.distinct: quite 相當 | justly 公正地
ex: The new policy is fairly easy to understand.
新政策相當容易理解。
Management must treat all employees fairly.
管理層必須公平對待所有員工。
It is fairly cold in the office today.
辦公室今天相當冷。

items.pos: adj. 下列的；隨後的 | prep. 在...之後
items.colloc: the following day 次日 | following the meeting 會後
items.distinct: next 下一個 | after 在...之後
ex: Please review the following documents.
請審閱下列文件。
Following the meeting, we had a quick lunch.
會議結束後，我們簡單吃了午餐。
I will update you on the following Monday.
我將在下個星期一向您更新狀況。

items.colloc: follow instructions 遵守指示 | clear instructions 明確的說明
items.distinct: direction 方向；指引 | guidance 指導
ex: Please read the instruction manual carefully.
請仔細閱讀使用說明書。
He gave clear instructions on how to proceed.
他對如何進行提供了明確的指示。
The software installation requires special instructions.
軟體安裝需要特別的說明。

items.colloc: be involved in 參與 | get involved 投入
items.distinct: participating 參加的 | complicated 複雜的
ex: Everyone involved in the project must attend.
所有參與該專案的人員都必須出席。
He is heavily involved in local community work.
他深度參與當地社區工作。
There are many factors involved in this decision.
這項決定涉及許多因素。

items.pos: n. 地點；職位 | v. 放置；下訂單
items.colloc: place an order 下訂單 | in place 在適當位置
items.distinct: location 地點 | position 職位
ex: We would like to place an order for ten units.
我們想要訂購十個單位。
Everything is in place for the conference.
會議的一切準備就緒。
Please place the document on my desk.
請將文件放在我的桌上。

items.colloc: popular with 受...歡迎 | popular demand 大眾需求
items.distinct: famous 有名的 | trendy 流行的
ex: This software is very popular among small businesses.
這款軟體在小型企業中非常受歡迎。
It is a popular choice for business travelers.
這是商務旅客的熱門選擇。
The store is popular for its high-quality service.
這家店以優質服務而聞名。

items.pos: adj. 有前途的；有希望的
items.colloc: promising career 有前途的職業 | promising candidate 有潛力的人選
items.distinct: hopeful 滿懷希望的 | potential 潛在的
ex: The new recruit is a very promising candidate.
這位新進人員是非常有潛力的人選。
We see promising growth in the Asian market.
我們在亞洲市場看到了有希望的成長。
He has a promising career ahead of him.
他有著前途無量的職涯。

items.colloc: commercial property 商業地產 | private property 私人財產
items.distinct: asset 資產 | real estate 不動產
ex: The company owns a lot of property in the city.
公司在市區擁有許多房地產。
Please do not leave your personal property unattended.
請勿讓您的個人物品無人看管。
We are looking to invest in commercial property.
我們正在尋求投資商業地產。

items.colloc: revised version 修訂版本 | revised budget 修改後的預算
items.distinct: updated 更新的 | edited 編輯過的
ex: Please submit the revised draft by tomorrow.
請在明天前提交修訂後的草稿。
The revised schedule will be sent shortly.
修訂後的行程表稍後會發送。
We reviewed the revised agreement yesterday.
我們昨天審閱了修改後的合約。

items.colloc: seating capacity 座位數 | seating arrangement 座位安排
items.distinct: seat 座位 | chair 椅子
ex: The venue has a seating capacity of five hundred.
該場地有五百個座位。
Please check the seating chart for your name.
請查看座位表找您的名字。
We need to change the seating arrangement for guests.
我們需要調整客人的座位安排。
